title: Grateful Dead Live at Capitol Theater on 1970-11-07
lineage: MAC > 7" reel@ 7.5 ips, no nr  technics rs-1506>hd-p2 24/96> hd>cd wave>adobe 2.0 16/44>flac

ai_review.summary: Decent audience recording with many cuts, giving a fragmented but still enjoyable snapshot of the show.
ai_review.review: The tape is praised as a decent audience (aud) capture for its era, though every set is incomplete and suffers from audible cuts and crowd chatter. While listeners appreciate having another piece of an otherwise missing performance, the interruptions limit its usefulness as a full concert experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review (3‑star) that notes both positive (decent for period) and negative (incomplete sets, cuts) aspects; rating reflects an average show with a fair recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Decent clarity for the time but marred by frequent song cuts and noticeable crowd chatter throughout.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Both sets are incomplete with many interruptions, resulting in a fragmented listening experience.
